q1_issues.issue: The relative clause "that included former winners ... as well as ... Michelle Wie" is a verbal (stative transitive) predicate of the kind the instruction set reifies as an event with an Agent subject, but no include event appears; its content is re-expressed as PartOf group-membership links (also statements 14 and 18).
The appositive typing atoms sit inside past-tense host clauses but carry no Past wrapper (also statements 12 and 15, and the Measure at statement 16).

q2_gaps: The privative/temporal modifier "former": the compound rule mandates the genus (Inheritance former_winner winner), which asserts present winner-hood, and nothing lets a modifier cancel or time-shift the head it fuses with.

Hyphenated attributive measure compounds as pre-nominal modifiers ("a 144-player field", "13-year-old phenom"): no rule says whether the number becomes a Cardinality/Measure or stays inside a compound-kind symbol.
"as well as" as an NP coordinator: the additive rule covers "also / too / as well" only as a clause-level focus particle taking (Also <filler> <event>).
notes: The nested group encoding (Member field + GroupOf player + Cardinality 144) and the 13-year-old Measure follow the instruction set exactly.
